correctness.rationale: The proof derives a=M(p+1)-xq, identifies all possible subset sums of a<pq, and uses two distinct terminal residues to contradict p>x(x-1) whenever a>=q. The exact converse follows from one residue. Range boundaries (positive k, strict prime ordering, x>=2, nonnegative coefficients) are explicitly covered. An exact standalone verifier agrees on 48596 eligible pairs through k=9; only the proof is used for the universal assertion.
